character: One of the highest resorts in the southern Alps at 2,000m. Mercantour National Park neighbour. 120km pistes, 90 min from Nice. Created by a British Olympic skier in 1971. Tour de France stage finish (1993, 2024). Craft brewery on site.
description: Isola 2000 was created in 1971 by British ex-army officer and Olympic skier Peter Boumphrey, who discovered the basin on a map. 120km of pistes, 43 runs (7 green, 21 blue, 11 red, 4 black), 22 lifts including 2 gondolas and 1 funicular. 75% snowmaking coverage. 2,610m summit, 1,840m base. Night skiing twice weekly during French holidays. 36 restaurants including Asian, creperie, pizza, mountain specialties — and a craft brewery (Brasserie du Kamous). 90 min from Nice Côte d'Azur Airport via regular 100% Neige express bus. Tour de France stage finishes in 1993 and 2024. French Alpine Ski Championships 2008.

non_ski_activities.nightlife: Le Crocodile Pub (nightclub, Tel: 04 93 23 18 80), Le Txupito (nightclub, Le Saint Pierre, Tel: 06 58 40 43 03).
non_ski_activities.activities: Battle Archery Paintball, White Wolf sled dog kennel, beach volleyball, pumptrack, tennis, mini-golf, climbing wall, Parc Aventure Isoliane (adventure park), bike park, via ferrata, snowshoeing, cross-country skiing (3km).
non_ski_activities.mercantour: Next to Mercantour National Park — exceptional biodiversity, guided wildlife walks, snowshoe trails.
non_ski_activities.tour_de_france: Stage finish 1993 and 2024. French Alpine Ski Championships 2008.
non_ski_activities.access: 90 min from Nice Côte d'Azur Airport. 100% Neige express bus service in winter. Regular bus from Nice, €1.00 tickets for locals.

honest_drawbacks: Purpose-built 1970s architecture — concrete main building considered ugly
Small compared to northern Alps giants (120km)
Southern Alps — snow less reliable than Tarentaise despite 2,000m altitude
Tree line means limited tree-skiing at resort altitude
